title: Patch the Planet's own page describes the program mechanics but no registry program file exists under the org
summary: The patch-the-planet org file exists but has zero linked programs. Trail of Bits' own page describes the program mechanics: security engineers pair with critical open-source projects (cURL, Python, Sigstore) for a dedicated review week producing patches and disclosures, and selected maintainers get six months of ChatGPT Pro/Codex access. No monetary award size or fixed deadline is published; application is via an in-page form.
